Spray Dried Raspberry Powder for Food Manufacturers

Raspberry powder is a dry, shelf-stable way to add bright red colour and a sweet, tangy berry flavour to food and drinks. Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried raspberry powder to beverage, confectionery, bakery and dairy manufacturers. Spray drying turns raspberry juice into a fine powder that keeps much of the fruit's natural colour and aroma. It dissolves easily and stays stable in storage, which makes it simple to work with in a factory. As a spray dried raspberry powder supplier, we make sure every batch follows the same process.

How the Powder Is Made

We start with ripe raspberries, carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. First, the juice is extracted to keep the full raspberry flavour. Next, it goes into a spray drying system. The system sprays the liquid as fine droplets into a stream of warm air, and the moisture evaporates almost instantly. Because drying happens so fast, the fruit's colour and aroma are well protected. Finally, the fine particles are collected and sieved into a consistent, free-flowing powder. That is why our wholesale spray dried raspberry powder keeps a fresher taste than many slow-dried alternatives. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Raspberry Powder?

Our powder is a practical choice for buyers who need a bulk spray dried raspberry powder supplier India. We know that consistency matters in larger production runs. We handle processing and packing ourselves, so we can keep each shipment uniform. The powder also dissolves well, which suits instant drinks and smooth confectionery fillings. Its concentrated flavour means you often need less of it in a recipe. That efficiency can help lower your ingredient costs.

Technical Specifications and Quality

We keep our quality approach clear and practical. Moisture is controlled below 5%, and our team checks every batch for colour and particle size. The powder is sieved to 80-100 mesh. Our records support full batch traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. If you need a dependable spray dried raspberry powder exporter, we are an FSSAI registered food business and IEC registered exporter, and we provide export documentation support with every order.

Applications Across Diverse Industries

Our powder works in many product types. Beverage companies use it in fruit drink powders and instant iced tea mixes. Confectioners use it in chocolates, gummies and fruit fillings. Bakeries use it in coatings, creams and fillings. Supplement brands use it as a natural fruit flavour in drink powders and chewables. It also performs well in yogurt, ice cream and breakfast cereals.

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried raspberry powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger bulk orders receive better pricing, and we review every inquiry individually so we can support businesses of any size. What documents and quality standards apply? We follow hygienic processing practices and written standard operating procedures (SOP). A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, processing)? Our standard grade is spray dried to 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Please contact us for the full product specification sheet.
